notes: Regression fixture for issue #101 — 12 near-coincident tri-state-area points, tight enough that stages 1 and 2 (non-overlap required) both fail and stage 3 (soft fallback) is forced. Not loaded by layout.test.ts or scripts/run-layout-tests.mjs (both only glob the flat fixtures/ directory, not this regression/ subdirectory) — used exclusively by stage3Termination.test.ts to verify stage 3 terminates within its time/combination budget rather than to assert a violation-free layout, since stage 3's contract is least-overlap, not overlap-free.
